handover_note: Unified Vector Storage Architecture Complete (v0.3.0). Major architectural refactoring: All memory tiers (short-term, mid-term, long-term) now use vector databases (Qdrant/Chroma/Pinecone) for persistent storage. Redis/NATS repositioned as coordination layer (Session, Lock, Cache, Message Queue). Solves data loss risk, enables semantic search, provides unified architecture. Complete FAQ system, 6 performance optimization modules, IP defense system. Production ready with comprehensive documentation. Next: Fix clear methods, integration testing, performance testing.
